title: Nine Members and One Kettle
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：association　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 association 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 my mother joined ① an association for people who kept bees, and said it was the first thing she had joined on purpose. The ② association, meaning the people and not the name, met nine times a year in a room above a library; an association, she said, is a club that has agreed to have a purpose. She said the purpose was honey and the club was something else.

Every ③ association in that town had the same nine members and the same two arguments, and she said that was how you knew it was working. Their ④ association with the library was nine pounds a year and one locked cupboard; an association, my father said, is the only thing people pay to belong to and then complain about. He said the cupboard was never unlocked.

My grandmother meant the other thing and meant ⑤ an association of ideas, by which she meant the smell of rain and the year 1958. The ⑥ association, meaning the connection and not the club, is the only thing in a head that nobody has joined and everybody belongs to; an association, she said, is a door between two things that were never introduced. She said the rain had been introducing them for years.

By 1976 the  association had thirty members and no bees, and my mother said that was the natural end of it. The ⑦ association she kept longest was with a woman in the next street, nine years of it, and it had no name at all; an association, my father said, is either a thing with a rulebook or a thing with a key. He said only one of them needs a lock.

The  association I remember is the one above the library, which had nine chairs and a kettle that never boiled. An ⑧ association, my mother said in 1984, is the only way of being alone with other people that anybody has ever invented; every association, she said, is a way of admitting you cannot do it by yourself. She said the admitting was the difficult half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 协会；社团（一个具体的组织）
B. n. 协会（指那些人，与名称相对）
C. 固定搭配：an association with somebody/something 与……的往来、关系
D. 固定搭配：join an association 加入一个协会
E. 固定搭配：an association of ideas 联想
F. n. 联系；关联（抽象）
G. n. 交往；交情（与人之间长期的来往）
H. n. 协会（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: an association for people who kept bees
The association, meaning the people and not the name
The association, meaning the connection and not the club
An association, my mother said in 1984

answers.why: join an association 意为“加入一个协会”，1972 年母亲加入了一个养蜂人的协会，她说那是她第一件有意加入的东西。
association 指“那些人”，与名称相对，这个协会每年在图书馆楼上的房间里聚九次。
association 意为“协会、社团”，那座镇上每一个协会有同样的九个成员和同样的两种争论。
an association with something 意为“与……的往来、关系”，他们与图书馆的关系是每年九镑加一个上锁的柜子。
an association of ideas 意为“联想”，祖母指的是雨的气味和 1958 年这件事之间的联想。
association 意为“联系、关联（抽象）”，指那种连接而不是那个社团，它是脑子里唯一没人加入过、人人却都属于的东西。
association 意为“交往、交情”，她维持最久的一段交情是和隔壁街上一位女人，长达九年，连名字也没有。
association 为抽象总称，母亲说协会是人类发明的唯一一种和别人一起独处的方式。
